onboard.code.title: Which group are you joining?
onboard.code.lead: Enter the group code you got from your workplace.
onboard.story.title: Choose your story
onboard.story.lead: The same missions and points, two ways to play.
onboard.story.note: You can change story later. You keep your name, points and badges.
story.gaarden.title: Full barn!
story.gaarden.pitch: You are a young nisse taken in by the nisse family. Every week another family member comes home to the barn.
story.laaven.title: Porridge for the nisse
story.laaven.pitch: You are a farmhand before Christmas. Every week you fill the pot so the barn nisse gets his Christmas porridge, with butter.
onboard.name.lead.gaarden: A nisse name fits best. Your colleagues never see your e-mail.
onboard.name.title.laaven: What are you called on the farm?
onboard.name.lead.laaven: An old farm name fits best. Your colleagues never see your e-mail.
onboard.code.label: Invite code
onboard.name.hint: 2 to 32 characters. You can change it later.
